audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle in both layers against a 47.46% win rate. The packet reads Malphite for rows 0-3 and Kayle for 4-6, the prose agrees (whys[1] 'concede the trade', whys[2] "don't fight", whys[3] 'hug tower', whys[4] 'you flip to the kiter here'), and the mirror auditor reached the same conclusion for rows 1 and 2 but was blocked from proposing it.
audit.why: Kayle is melee and dashless into a 625-range slow that steals her move speed, plus an attack-speed cut from Ground Slam. The lane genuinely belongs to Malphite until Divine Ascent's ranged tier at 6.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-3 set to Malphite, row 4 to Kayle — five matched full/content pairs. Rows 5-6 already Kayle, which the mirror confirms.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] — the Levels 4-5 row — says 'His Unstoppable Force is online'. It is not; Malphite's ultimate arrives at 6, the row after. No cooldown numbers appear anywhere either.
audit.why: The row tells a player to hug tower at level 4 because of an ability that does not exist yet, and then the level-6 row has to introduce the same threat again. The mirror auditor added the 160s figure from the other side; both directions should carry it.
audit.corrected: whys[3] rewritten to the threat that is actually live at 4-5 (Q slow plus W armour against a melee Kayle). Divine Judgment's 160s and Unstoppable Force's 130s written into whys[4] and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions absent. (a) Ground Slam deals magic damage based on his Armor, and Radiant Blast reduces the resistances of everything it hits — so one Q cast lowers both his durability and his damage. (b) Granite Shield recharges if he goes a few seconds without being hit.
audit.why: (a) is the decisive interaction of the matchup and the mirror auditor flagged its absence from both layers; the page's whole plan is 'he stacks armour, shred him', and it never says that the shred also defuses his damage. (b) changes how you poke: single pokes with walk-away gaps refund themselves, so chip must come in one sustained window.
audit.corrected: The Radiant Blast / Ground Slam link written into whys[5] and mid; Granite Shield's recharge written into mid. Did not act on the brief's 'resistances-invalidated' rule as stated — see notes.
sources: enemyKit E text (damage based on his Armor)
ownerKit Q text (reducing the resistances of all hit)
enemyKit P text (recharges if not hit for a few seconds)

audit.why: 47.46% over 847 games — a losing lane labelled EVEN. The chart flips above at least stop the page claiming Kayle owns the early levels she loses.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flags 'His Unstoppable Force' in whys[3].
audit.why: The name is right; the timing was wrong. Corrected under point 3.

edits.before: His Unstoppable Force is online and any all-in through the Q slow kills an escape-less, still-melee Kayle — hug tower.
edits.after: His Q slow and W armour still beat a melee, escape-less Kayle, and one bad step-up is a free jungle kill — hug tower.

edits.before: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged AoE and R invuln blanks his Unstoppable Force engage — you flip to the kiter here.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment (160s) blanks Unstoppable Force (130s) — you flip to the kiter right here.

edits.before: Nashor's plus E missing-health on-hit shred his armor stack while you kite his Q — your first item out-DPSes his tank build.
edits.after: Radiant Blast cuts his resists, and Ground Slam scales off his armour, so shredding him lowers his damage too — Nashor's out-DPSes him.

edits.before: Level 6 is your first breath: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged AoE magic waves and R hands you a few seconds of full invulnerability, so his R engage and Q slow stop being a death sentence — pop R when he ults onto you and walk away while it whiffs. Now you can finally kite him, farm safely, and start stacking Q armor-and-MR shred plus E missing-health on-hit into a tank who built armor, not magic resist. Once your first AP item comes online you out-DPS him in a straight fight; bait the Unstoppable Force, blank it with R, then kite back and melt him.
edits.after: Level 6 is your first breath: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged AoE magic waves and R hands you a few seconds of full invulnerability, so his R engage and Q slow stop being a death sentence — pop R when he ults onto you and walk away while it whiffs. Now you kite him and stack Radiant Blast's resistance shred, which also cuts Ground Slam, since that damage scales off his armour. Do not chip and walk away: Granite Shield recharges whenever he goes a few seconds untouched, so poke in one sustained window or not at all.

edits.before: Un-dodgeable burst. R-invuln it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 130s of un-dodgeable burst — R through it, or fight only once it is spent.

notes: Did not act on the brief's missing-interaction rule as worded: it says Granite Shield means 'Malphite bypasses stacking resistances'. Riot's text describes a damage-absorbing shield worth 10% of his max health that recharges out of combat — that is not resistance bypass, and telling the player their resists are invalid here would be wrong. I took the genuine mechanic out of the same text instead: the recharge punishes hit-and-walk-away poke. The valuable find is the mirror's — Radiant Blast's resistance shred also cuts Ground Slam, because that ability's damage scales off his armour. Written into whys[5] and mid from this side, phrased to match the Malphite page. Chart rows 0-3 flipped to Malphite: the mirror auditor identified rows 1-2 and was blocked from proposing them, so this direction carries the fix.
